module.name: roksbnkctl-bnkforge-sshcred
module.description: Give BNK Forge the SSH PRIVATE key for an appliance this deployment built, and attach it to the project so Forge can reach the appliance itself.

required.name: ssh_private_key_secret
required.description: Name of the BNK Forge PROJECT SECRET holding the appliance's PRIVATE key, unencrypted. Forge materializes it into the run workspace as a file; it is never passed on the command line. Forge stores the key and cannot prompt, so an encrypted key cannot be used.

required.name: bnkforge_url
required.description: BNK Forge URL to store the credential in.

required.name: bnkforge_password
required.description: BNK Forge password. Passed as an environment variable only, never on the command line.

optional.name: appliance_host
optional.description: The address FORGE must reach the appliance on — the FLOATING IP, not the private endpoint the appliance reports. An FLP publishes https://10.243.1.4:8443, which is inside the services VPC that Forge sits outside of, so a credential built from it can never connect. Wired from the flp module's floating_ip output when an flp is in this deployment; set it yourself otherwise, e.g. for a harbor VSI.

optional.name: ssh_username
optional.description: SSH user on the appliance. ubuntu for the FLP and Harbor VSI images.

optional.name: credential_name
optional.description: Name for the credential in Forge. Blank uses <project>-ssh.

optional.name: bnkforge_project
optional.description: BNK Forge project to attach the credential to. Blank uses this project.

optional.name: bnkforge_insecure
optional.description: Set true only for a Forge with a self-signed certificate. Prefer bnkforge_ca_b64.

optional.name: bnkforge_ca_b64
optional.description: Base64 PEM of the CA that issued Forge's certificate, pinning the call.
